acceptance: The R4 claim remains an ordinary standard-v2 transfer from terminal R3 and its baselines equal the exact frozen R3 candidate blobs.

The separate packet outside docs/plans/evidence is mandatory and binds normalized path, pin, captured raw Git blob, closed nineteen-field semantics and canonical digest to the router reference and claim.
The sole candidate Evidence remains the unchanged exact ACTIVE_FREEZE_EVIDENCE_FIELDS object and is never used as architecture authority.
forbidden: new origin mode, generic authority layer, loader, capture, lifecycle or Evidence schema
dual-role Evidence or architecture packet under docs/plans/evidence
third writer path, productive fixture discovery or second same-class correction
live, provider, host, private-data, network, expensive test, stage, commit, push or deploy
hostile_matrix: missing architecture reference or packet document
packet path missing, inside or aliased into docs/plans/evidence, equal or aliased to candidate Evidence, or overlapping writer scope
packet pin, captured blob id, raw-byte Git blob or router packet blob drift
missing, extra, malformed or semantically changed packet field
terminal R3 source candidate map, R4 baseline map, allowed paths, architecture revision or published revision drift
candidate Evidence alias, schema drift or active-freeze bijection drift
post-capture document mutation and productive fixture file, Git, subprocess or auxiliary-loader access
stop_rule: After one bounded correction, any recurrence of R4 packet authority binding, terminal-baseline continuity or synthetic-fixture isolation releases the claim blocked and triggers the control-plane circuit breaker; do not author R5.
threat_model: A standard-v2 successor could otherwise accept while its separate stable product packet is deleted, forged or semantically detached; the exact R4 hook binds terminal R3 candidate baselines, normalized packet path, captured raw Git blob, canonical semantic digest, closed packet fields and ordinary candidate Evidence.

verification_tiers.central: real integration-spine CLI plus integration-spine, parallel-roadmap and multi-agent-guidance suites
verification_tiers.focused: five exact R4 packet, predecessor-baseline, active-freeze and zero-read nodes
verification_tiers.independent_qa: fresh hostile review on one exact frozen candidate
verification_tiers.sol_review: fresh Deep-Sol re-derivation on the same exact candidate
